description: Mutate Everything cDNA stability data with our internal protein-level development split (104 train / 12 val proteins from the released cdna_train set); the released cDNA2 test set is held out and unread during development.

labels.canonical: score = WT-relative ddG, positive = stabilizing; replicate measurements reduced by median

val.policy: 10% of released-train sequence groups, numpy seed 0; identical sequences kept together. Our validation policy, not an upstream split.

test.policy: released cDNA2 test, immutable; read only after configurations are frozen (--final-test)

alternate_splits.mutate_everything_cdna_holdout1: same development proteins re-split with seed 1 (first written by experiments/start_mutate_everything_accuracy_v2.py; rebuilt by make -C datasets mutate-everything-holdouts); sensitivity check, not an independent test

metrics.selection: validation only (macro overall Spearman or doubles RMSE, per the experiment's declared --selection rule)
metrics.external: per experiments/stability_paper/me_esm2_v1/comparison.json via mutant_cache.matched_suite; published reproduction checks: cDNA2 nDCG@30 0.38, S669 Spearman 0.47

notes: This is the E02 development protocol. The completed full-116-protein fixed-final comparison (experiments/mutate_everything_full_comparison/) merged train+val and is a different training membership.
Exact-sequence overlap against ESM-MSR splits is audited (manifest.json external_sign_audit); the MMseqs2 identity ceiling reported upstream is not verified (identity_ceiling_verified=false).
